title.zh: Amp接入Claude订阅，底层直接换成Claude Code
title.en: Amp接入Claude订阅，底层直接换成Claude Code

current_state.zh: AI coding tool Amp added a Claude Code mode that runs Anthropic's official Claude Code via the Claude Agent SDK, letting all users draw on their Claude Pro/Max subscription limits instead of purchasing separate Amp credits, while retaining Amp's cloud computers, task sharing, collaboration and agent orchestration features.
